extDescription.message: Real-time AI translation for Google Chat with your own LLM API key.

outgoing_saveAsDefault.message: Save as this room's default language

outgoing_translationPlaceholder.message: The translation appears here. You can edit it.

outgoing_richWarning.message: Mentions and formatting are dropped from the translation (attachments are kept)

outgoing_sendFailed.message: Could not send. Press Enter in the composer to send the translation yourself.

outgoing_error_auth.message: The API key is not valid. Check the key in settings.

outgoing_error_rate_limit.message: Too many requests. Try again in a moment.

outgoing_error_server.message: The translation service had a problem. Try again.

outgoing_error_bad_request.message: The request could not be processed. Check the model settings.

outgoing_error_parse.message: The translation could not be read. Try again.

outgoing_error_unknown.message: The translation request failed. Try again.

bg_badgeNoKey.message: No API key. Enter a key in the settings.

bg_badgeInvalidKey.message: The API key is invalid. Check the key in the settings.

bg_badgeBroken.message: Could not read the Google Chat page. The extension may need an update.

options_sectionProviderHelp.message: API keys are stored only on this device and are never synced.

options_apiKeyOptionalHelp.message: May be left empty depending on the service. Stored on this device only.

options_modelHelp.message: You can type any model name.

options_baseUrlHelp.message: e.g. https://host/v1 — saving asks for access permission to that origin.

options_baseUrlInvalid.message: Invalid URL. It must start with http:// or https://.

options_baseUrlPermissionDenied.message: Permission was denied, so the URL was not saved.

options_instructionsHelp.message: Instructions passed along with every translation (tone, terms, etc.).

options_maxMessageCharsHelp.message: Longer messages are not translated automatically.

options_maxAutoPerRoomHelp.message: Only the newest messages up to this count are translated automatically.

options_limitInvalid.message: Enter a whole number of 1 or more.

options_sectionRoomsHelp.message: Settings changed inside a room are collected here.

options_roomInstructionsHelp.message: Added after the global extra instructions and applied only to this room.

options_roomInstructionsPlaceholder.message: e.g. Use a casual tone in this room.

options_clearHistoryHelp.message: Deletes all cached translations and your original-text records on this device.

options_clearHistoryConfirm.message: Really clear? This cannot be undone.

options_quotaBanner.message: Sync storage quota exceeded — the setting was not saved. Try removing per-room settings or shortening the instructions.

options_invalidKeyBanner.message: The $PROVIDER$ API key was rejected. Please check the key.

options_brokenBanner.message: Google Chat's layout may have changed, so the extension might not work.

popup_noKeyBanner.message: No API key. Add one in settings.

popup_invalidKeyBanner.message: The API key was rejected. Check it in settings.
